targets.authors: Yasuda, Y., Ito, S., Matsumoto, J., et al.
targets.title: Proposal for a Novel Classification of Patients With Enlarged Ventricles and Cognitive Impairment Based on Data‐Driven Analysis of Neuroimaging Results in Patients With Psychiatric Disorders
targets.evidence_quote: In our previous study [ 6 ], we performed data‐driven classification based on large‐scale neuroimaging datasets to identify a novel subtype of psychiatric disorders characterized by pronounced EV and CI (i.e., EVCI).
targets.outcome_quote: This study validated the existence of the EVCI subgroup in independent cohorts, thus supporting our previous findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall validation verdict. Other COCORO cohorts supply a different sample, although ventricular data had previously been assembled.

reasoning: Independent cohorts test the previously identified EVCI subtype. Prior imaging analyses and clinical case series are background or data sources, not additional re-tested findings.
